instruction: Help me make the Properties panel visible on the right so I can adjust settings.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(5); pyautogui.press('esc'); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('f10'); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('right', presses=2, interval=0.1); time.sleep(0.3); pyautogui.press('down', presses=11, interval=0.1); pyautogui.press('enter')

metadata.explanation: This task requires the user to show the Properties panel in LibreOffice Impress. The config hides the left slide panel using keyboard shortcuts (F10 menu navigation). The task asks to show the Properties panel instead, which typically appears on the right side. The evaluator checks the accessibility tree for the presence of a Properties panel. This is similar difficulty to the original task - both involve showing/hiding UI panels in Impress.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary score: 1.0 if Properties panel is visible, 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly identifies Properties panel by searching for panels with 'properties' in the name (lines 33-39)

Second pass correctly searches for property indicators ONLY within the Properties panel's subtree using 'properties_panel_element.iter()' (line 54), preventing false positives from text elsewhere in UI
Logic correctly returns 0.0 if Properties panel exists but contains no property controls (lines 61-64), ensuring the panel is actually showing properties
Property indicators list is comprehensive and covers common property groups in LibreOffice Impress (position, fill, line, area, shadow, character, paragraph, animation, etc.)
Error handling is appropriate with try/except and logging (lines 65-67)
The evaluator can semantically verify the instruction requirement: that the Properties panel is visible and functional
